title: Expose the SR measures in the semantic model and rewrite dax_measure_library.md §6.1
description: Add gold_supply_risk to the TMDL semantic model with its relationships, define the three Supply Risk measures, and update the DAX measure library from plain concentration to the SR measures.
acceptanceCriteria: gold_supply_risk is in the TMDL model with relationships consistent with fact_supply_share (yearly grain, no date relationship).
Measures defined: Supply Risk (Global), Supply Risk (EU Sourcing), and Supply Risk Contrast = DIVIDE([Supply Risk (EU Sourcing)], [Supply Risk (Global)]) — blank when the global index is 0.
MIGRATION — the existing Supply Concentration measure is filtered to supply_mix = 'global' (spec § Semantic Model and § Business Logic both now specify this).
dax_measure_library.md §6.1 is rewritten from plain concentration to the SR measures, and documents the WGI vintage/aggregation rule as spec'd.
Erik refreshes the DirectLake model and confirms the measures resolve without errors.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-29 by /breakdown task-038 (parent difficulty 7). Seams follow the parent's proposed breakdown, re-cut against the spec as amended 2026-07-29 (§ Business Logic & Calculations → Supply Risk, and § Data Architecture → fact_supply_share). Parent ACs were written 2026-07-19 and predate that amendment — the criteria below supersede them where they differ.
SEAM (e), model half. No notebook files touched — the only subtask with no overlap against 038_1..038_4, but it depends on the table existing so it cannot start early.
Criterion 3 is the semantic-model half of the same double-count migration as task-038_2 criterion 3. Both must land or the concentration figures silently include EU rows.

[IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-01] implementation_status: completed. Exposed SR measures in the TMDL semantic model + rewrote dax_measure_library.md §6.1 (5 files). Created gold_supply_risk.tmdl (8 cols matching 038_4 actual schema: material_key, stage_key, year, hhi_global, hhi_eu_sourcing, contrast_ratio, is_bottleneck, incomplete_wgi_coverage — NOT the stale spec L731 list) with directLake partition; added ref to model.tmdl; two relationships in relationships.tmdl (material_key→gold_dim_material, stage_key→gold_dim_stage — yearly grain, NO date relationship, NO country relationship). SR measures: Supply Risk (Global)=MAX(hhi_global), Supply Risk (EU Sourcing)=MAX(hhi_eu_sourcing), Supply Risk Contrast=DIVIDE([EU],[Global]) (BLANK on /0 matches blank-when-global-0 + NULL-not-0). Criterion 3 migration: TMDL had NO pre-existing Supply Concentration measure (confirmed — 0 measures on fact_supply_share.tmdl, matches 038_2 note); interpreted 'migrate' as 'add it correctly the first time with supply_mix=global filter' → added Supply Concentration Index measure to fact_supply_share.tmdl (=CALCULATE(MAX(share_pct), supply_mix="global")) + declared the supply_mix column. DEC-010 records this interpretation. Aggregation form = MAX (matches existing Max Supply Concentration precedent; SUM/MAX/AVG collapse at the unique grain; MAX avoids summing across stages/years when filter context is coarser). DEC-011 records this. Rewrote dax_measure_library.md §6.1 from plain concentration to SR measures + WGI vintage/aggregation rule (mean of six, latest year per country with all six, fixed-bound clamp, inversion mandatory — spec L1319-1327) + Supply Concentration (secondary lens, retained, supply_mix=global filter). Removed legacy plain-concentration measures (HHI Index, HHI Category, Top 3 Supply Concentration %, High Risk Material Count) from §6.1 and updated all in-file cross-references (§6.3 Composite Risk Score, TOC, Phase 5 checklist, Q9/Q10, Summary). FR-041 re-confirmed (spec L731 omits incomplete_wgi_coverage). FR-042 logged: spec § Semantic Model L797 lists Supply Concentration Index as a representative measure but the TMDL did not contain it (added). FR-043 logged: terminology mismatch — 'Supply Concentration Index' (§ Semantic Model L797) vs 'Supply Concentration' (§ Business Logic L1423) vs 'Max Supply Concentration %' (existing library); aligned to § Semantic Model name. NON-BLOCKING FOLLOW-UPS (3, suggested → new tasks): (1) out-of-scope docs reference the removed legacy measures — semantic_model.md L145-146, star-schema-erd.md L134, PORTFOLIO_DESIGN.md L154-238 now dangle against rewritten §6.1; (2) project_definition.md L807 lists 'Supply Concentration Index = MAX(fact_supply_share[share_pct])' WITHOUT supply_mix=global filter — same migration gap in a file outside declared files_affected; (3) fact_supply_share.tmdl now declares supply_mix but the `t` trade-param column (038_2) remains undeclared — no measure references it, nothing breaks. Verification: no local pytest for TMDL/DAX (Fabric runtime); self-review matched TMDL syntax via cat -e -t, validated DAX expressions, confirmed §6.1 reflects spec. Criterion 5 (DirectLake refresh, measures resolve) is Erik's half. user_review_pending: true.

[FABRIC REVIEW CONFIRMED 2026-08-01] Update from Git landed clean (commit 941e3b4). First DirectLake refresh surfaced a transient web-editor edit-collision error ('The change you were making failed to apply...') — TMDL verified structurally sound (partition, 8 cols, 2 relationships mirroring working fact_supply_share pattern, model.tmdl ref); retry from the semantic model context menu (not in-editor) succeeded. gold_supply_risk bound in the model with 8 columns + 3 SR measures; Supply Concentration Index present on fact_supply_share. In report2 (scratch 'SR verify' page): all 4 measures resolve with no DAX errors in a table visual (material_name on rows). Supply Risk Contrast blank on EU-coverage-gap materials (not 0). Supply Concentration Index reads on 0-100 percentage scale (supply_mix=global filter, no EU double-count). Bottleneck spot-check: is_bottleneck=TRUE filter returns the single bottleneck stage's hhi_global, not a sum across stages. user_review_pending cleared. Note: Fabric detected a workspace->git change after refresh (regenerated model metadata) — deferred commit, to sync after verification.

steps.instruction: Trigger a DirectLake refresh of the semantic model (lakehouse tables populated by task-038_4).

steps.instruction: Open report2.Report and add the four new measures to a visual (Supply Risk (Global), Supply Risk (EU Sourcing), Supply Risk Contrast, Supply Concentration Index).
